TOK=open('/tmp/gh_tok').read().strip()
REPO='ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform'
TAG='v1.10.14-qa'
APK='/home/user/rork-app/expo/android/app/build/outputs/apk/qa/app-qa.apk'

body=json.dumps({
    'tag_name':TAG,
    'name':'IVX Holdings v1.10.14 QA',
    'body':'QA APK for IVX Holdings v1.10.14 (versionCode 112).\n\nSHA256: ca0ae24234b0c1a33848fc13341e0c7da3a5977601b65268c820fd5552bbbe18',
    'draft':False,
    'prerelease':True,
}).encode()

req=urllib.request.Request(f'https://api.github.com/repos/{REPO}/releases',data=body,headers={'Authorization':f'token {TOK}','Accept':'application/vnd.github.v3+json','Content-Type':'application/json'},method='POST')
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=30) as r:
        rel=json.loads(r.read())
        print('release created:', rel['html_url'])
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    if e.code==422:
        req2=urllib.request.Request(f'https://api.github.com/repos/{REPO}/releases/tags/{TAG}',headers={'Authorization':f'token {TOK}','Accept':'application/vnd.github.v3+json'})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req2,timeout=30) as r:
            rel=json.loads(r.read())
            print('release exists:', rel['html_url'])
    else:
        print(f'create release HTTP {e.code}: {e.read()[:300]}')
        raise SystemExit(1)

upload_url=rel['upload_url'].replace('{?name,label}','')
asset_name='ivx-holdings-v1.10.14.apk'

for a in rel.get('assets',[]):
    if a['name']==asset_name:
        print(f'deleting existing asset {a["id"]}')
        reqd=urllib.request.Request(f'https://api.github.com/repos/{REPO}/releases/assets/{a["id"]}',headers={'Authorization':f'token {TOK}','Accept':'application/vnd.github.v3+json'},method='DELETE')
        urllib.request.urlopen(reqd,timeout=30)

fsize=os.path.getsize(APK)
print(f'uploading {fsize} bytes...')
with open(APK,'rb') as f: data=f.read()

req=urllib.request.Request(f'{upload_url}?name={asset_name}',data=data,headers={'Authorization':f'token {TOK}','Accept':'application/vnd.github.v3+json','Content-Type':'application/vnd.android.package-archive'},method='POST')
with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=180) as r:
    asset=json.loads(r.read())
    print(f'asset uploaded: {asset["browser_download_url"]}')
    print(f'size: {asset["size"]}')

req=urllib.request.Request(asset['browser_download_url'],method='HEAD')
with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=30) as r:
    print(f'verified: HTTP {r.status} | content-length={r.headers.get("content-length")}')

print(f'\nGITHUB RELEASES DOWNLOAD LINK:')
print(asset['browser_download_url'])
EOF
